claims.head: Forecheck against patience
claims.body: On forecheck pressure, Utah is near the top of the league, but Pittsburgh is the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Expect the Mammoth to win more pucks back deep in the Penguins’ end.

claims.head: Bruisers against finesse
claims.body: The Mammoth hit a lot, but the Penguins mostly don’t. Utah is near the top of the league for physicality, and Pittsburgh is the worst. Expect most of the big hits to come from the Mammoth.

notes.text: Trevor van Riemsdyk is day to day (lower body injury) and has missed the last 3 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Spencer Stastney has taken his spot beside Kris Letang.
Egor Chinakhov is out (lower-body injury) and missed their last game. He is a top-six forward. Ville Koivunen has taken his spot beside Evgeni Malkin and Tommy Novak.
Spencer Stastney joined from EDM on Oct 7 and has played beside Kris Letang.

UTA.head: Advantage, the Mammoth
UTA.body: Even though Utah will be without Carcone, the Mammoth have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage. The Penguins’ way back in is getting good looks.

PIT.head: The Penguins face a real test
PIT.body: Even though Utah will be without Carcone, the Mammoth have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage. The Penguins can pull it off if they get good looks.
